771 
772     requested = local_path.expanduser()
773     absolute_requested = requested.absolute()
774     path_chain = [absolute_requested, *absolute_requested.parents]

784         raise ValueError("共享目录必须是本机真实文件夹，不能是符号链接")
785     roots = _safe_shared_roots(config)
786     for item in roots:
787         existing = Path(str(item["local_path"]))
788         if resolved == existing or resolved in existing.parents or existing in resolved.parents:
789             raise ValueError("共享目录与已有目录重复或相互嵌套，请只保留最合适的一层")

808         }
809     )
810     roots.append(root)

812     _save_config(config_path, config)
